writtenAt: ML1, before any UI or domain code
convention: A test title starts with the scenario id in brackets, e.g. [K]. The integrity test fails if a scenario has no test or a recorded result disagrees with the run. status PLANNED is replaced by the run result at ML8.

scenarios.title: No meal entries
scenarios.setup: real ready household, zero meals, zero tasks
assertions: A1 view.isEmpty is true
A2 upNext holds today and tomorrow groups with no entries
A3 no attention, score, gap or failure key exists anywhere in the view
A4 the empty copy is exactly 'No meals planned yet.' and a primary 'Add a meal' action exists

scenarios.title: Loading / hydrating state
scenarios.setup: store status hydrating; bound device with sync hydration unhydrated and hydrating; ready
assertions: B1 mealsScreenState is loading while the store is not ready
B2 mealsScreenState is loading while an account-bound device hydration is not ready
B3 the empty copy is never produced in loading
B4 an unbound local household in ready state is ready

scenarios.title: One entry
scenarios.setup: one active dinner entry for today
assertions: C1 the entry view carries id, logicalDate, mealSlot, title, scope, provenance, lifecycle
C2 semantic is planning-record, plannedState planned, executionState not-tracked
C3 it appears in the today group of upNext
C4 unknownFacts lists ingredients, allergens, nutrition, pantry

scenarios.title: Several dates
scenarios.setup: entries on today, tomorrow, +5, +14, +15, +40
assertions: D1 today and tomorrow are in upNext
D2 +5 and +14 are in nextDays, +15 and +40 are in later
D3 days without entries are not present in nextDays
D4 groups ascend by date

scenarios.title: Several entries on one date
scenarios.setup: breakfast, dinner, snack and unspecified entries on one date
assertions: E1 all four are present
E2 order is breakfast, dinner, snack, unspecified
E3 the order is identical after shuffling state.meals

scenarios.title: Several entries on one date and slot
scenarios.setup: three dinner entries on one date
assertions: F1 all three survive with distinct ids
F2 order is by id compared by code unit, not locale
F3 order is stable across shuffles of state.meals

scenarios.title: UNSPECIFIED slot
scenarios.setup: addMeal with no slot
assertions: G1 slot is unspecified, never dinner
G2 the sheet default shows meal type 'Not set' with no chip selected
G3 an unspecified entry shows no slot label and sorts last within its day

scenarios.title: Other closed-enum slots
scenarios.setup: one entry per slot value, then an invalid value
assertions: H1 each of the six values survives persistence, projection push and apply
H2 an invalid slot is rejected by the schema and refused by apply, never coerced
H3 slot ranks are breakfast 0, lunch 1, dinner 2, snack 3, other 4, unspecified 5

scenarios.title: Create
scenarios.setup: addMeal on a real ready household and a demo household
assertions: I1 a new stable id, status active, scope household, the Meals category
I2 provenance is user-action, or demo-seed in a demo household
I3 the title is normalized: trimmed, line breaks collapsed, at most 120
I4 refusals invalid-title, invalid-date, plan-full and no-meals-context return the SAME state reference
I5 the change observer queues a create intent in the same envelope

scenarios.title: Edit title
scenarios.setup: updateMeal with a new title
assertions: J1 same id, only title changed
J2 provenance is not restamped
J3 an unchanged title is a same-reference no-op
J4 an update intent is queued

scenarios.title: Move date
scenarios.setup: updateMeal with a new date
assertions: K1 the same stable id moves, entry count is unchanged
K2 no duplicate is created
K3 an invalid date is refused
K4 the date string is stored exactly as given

scenarios.title: Change slot
scenarios.setup: updateMeal with a new slot
assertions: L1 same id, slot changed, every other field intact
L2 changing back to unspecified is allowed

scenarios.title: Move into an occupied date and slot
scenarios.setup: entry X dinner Tue, entry Y moved to dinner Tue
assertions: M1 both entries exist with their own ids
M2 neither was overwritten or merged
M3 the move is not refused

scenarios.title: Archive / remove
scenarios.setup: archiveMeal on an active entry
assertions: N1 status becomes archived and the row is retained with its id
N2 it is excluded from the view, from upcomingMeals and from the Life status
N3 archiving an archived entry is refused as a same-reference no-op
N4 an archived entry cannot be edited or moved

scenarios.title: Archive propagates to a second device
scenarios.setup: two composeAccountApp devices over the fake cloud, and the real-database journey
assertions: O1 device A archives, syncs, device B pulls
O2 B's active view no longer shows the entry
O3 B holds the row with status archived
O4 the real PostgreSQL journey shows the same

scenarios.title: Removed does not become skipped or eaten
scenarios.setup: archive an entry and inspect observations and copy
assertions: P1 state.observations is unchanged by archive
P2 no skipped, completed or eaten value exists on the entry or view
P3 no copy the screen can produce says skipped or eaten

scenarios.title: A past planned entry does not become eaten
scenarios.setup: an active entry dated three days before today
assertions: Q1 it stays a planning record with executionState not-tracked
Q2 it is not in upNext or nextDays
Q3 it can appear in planAgain and nowhere as eaten, cooked or completed
Q4 the row is unchanged by the passage of time

scenarios.title: A blank date stays neutral
scenarios.setup: a fortnight with one entry
assertions: R1 blank days are not rendered in nextDays
R2 no gap, missing, unplanned or attention key exists
R3 a blank today or tomorrow reads 'No meals planned.' in muted tone

scenarios.title: No planning score or streak
scenarios.setup: structural key scan of the view and every copy string
assertions: S1 no score, streak, percent, complete, completion or weekly key
S2 no digits-with-percent or 'x of y planned' string can be produced

scenarios.title: Plan This Again creates a new stable entry

assertions: T1 the draft carries title and slot and defaults the date to logical today as a visible value
T2 saving creates a NEW entry with a new id
T3 provenance is user-action and stores no lineage
T4 no recurrence rule, favorite or library entity is created

scenarios.title: The original is unchanged after Plan This Again
scenarios.setup: snapshot the source entry, plan again, compare
assertions: U1 the source row keeps its object reference
U2 the source row deep-equals its snapshot
U3 state.recurrenceRules is unchanged

AX4 a legacy title of 200 characters stays valid

scenarios.title: Life hub row is truthful (resume brief)
scenarios.setup: deriveLifeStatus with none, one, archived-only and far-future entries

mutants.what: apply.ts converts meal_date through an explicit-zone instant so Tuesday becomes Monday
the projection marks a past active entry as eaten
the projection or Today treats a blank day as needing attention
a completed grocery task is projected as verified inventory
prep completion marks the meal served
an absent allergy record is projected as safe
an assigned or accepted task is projected as covered
moving a date creates a duplicate instead of moving the stable id
moving into an occupied date and slot overwrites the existing entry
a policy mutant in a scratch database lets an unrelated account access meal rows
the production sync composition is disconnected
a stale editor is allowed to overwrite newer state
the screen gate renders empty while hydration is incomplete
archive is not sent, so it stays active on the second device
a meal-derived due date is persisted without the explicit confirmation
a second durable Meals model file is added
an untouched default duration is recorded as user-provided
archive appends a skipped observation
Plan This Again mutates the source entry
ordering compares ids with localeCompare
